stem:
The box plots show the numbers of lessons completed by individual students enrolled in an online program at two different schools.

Online Program

School 1

School 2

Number of Lessons Completed

Which statement is best supported by the data in the box plots?

options.label: A
options.text: The range of the data for School 1 is greater than the range of the data for School 2.

options.label: B
options.text: The median of the data for School 2 is greater than the median of the data for School 1.

options.label: C
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for School 2 is greater than the interquartile range of the data for School 1.

options.label: D
options.text: The students at School 1 completed more lessons than the students at School 2.

visual_elements: box plot for School 1 with min ~3, Q1 ~5, median ~6, Q3 ~9, max ~13
box plot for School 2 with min ~1, Q1 ~4, median ~7, Q3 ~9, max ~13
number line from 1 to 13 labeled 'Number of Lessons Completed'
